title: Veyro 3.1.0
changelog: Content Blocking — in-tunnel ad, tracker and public-tracker domain blocking (toggle per category)
Exit-IP card — see the IP the world sees, with IP & DNS protection check
Privacy Scorecard in Diagnostics — score ring measuring IP protection, DNS privacy and HTTPS reachability
7-day usage history with bar chart on Speed tab
Node stability chips on the Nodes list (from benchmark history)
Hysteria2 protocol support (import hysteria2:// / hy2:// links)
Auto-Switch (urltest) — the core hops to the fastest node on its own
Per-app split tunneling — choose which apps ride the tunnel
Quick Settings tile for one-tap connect/disconnect
Live-speed notification with session timer and Disconnect action
Always-On VPN support (system kill switch ready)
